tb21_profile.skill: Design a biological sequence that satisfies a long list of interacting hard constraints, after pulling the right reference sequences out of external sources (PDB/FPbase APIs, FASTA, GenBank) and reverse-translating with GC-window control
tb21_profile.domain: Molecular biology / synthetic biology: protein and DNA sequences, FASTA and GenBank parsing, fluorescent protein spectra, antibody targets, ligand binding, codon usage
tb21_profile.task_form: implement-from-spec design task judged by a constraint checklist; requires external data retrieval plus multi-constraint construction of one output file

searches: tools.py words all "FASTA" "GenBank" "codon" "GC content" "plasmid" "primer" "biopython" "amino acid" "nucleotide" "reverse complement" -n 40
tools.py search all "GC content|codon|reverse complement|open reading frame|translate the (DNA|sequence)" -n 30
tools.py search rts "query the .* API|REST API .* retriev|fetch .* from the (API|server)|must satisfy (all )?the following constraints|constraints? (listed|described) in" -n 25

notes: Nothing in the pool is a sequence-design task with an external-API dependency; TMax's primer-design family is the only genuine design-under-biological-constraints work and dominates the final list. The dominant false positive across TMax is 'bioinformatics data analysis' (GC-content statistics, fluorescence curve fitting, ODE pipelines): the vocabulary matches but the skill is numerical data processing, not constrained sequence construction, so I kept those out. Recursive-Task-Synthesis is genuinely weak: only about six biology tasks exist (wgsim, refgenie, GenomeGraphs), so I filled the rest with API-query-and-emit-exact-output tasks and scored them 2. SWE-Smith has no biology at all; its best offerings are sequence-alignment algorithm bugs (Smith-Waterman, LCS on DNA strings), and rank 10 there is quota filler with no real transfer.
